note: Tennessee State Parks, Burns, ~35 mi west of Nashville. Campground along Four Mile Creek with three bathhouses; about 20 electric sites back onto the creek (79-93 and 100-121 on the west side). Four people per site. Closed for renovations; Lake Woodhaven was drained in August 2026 for infrastructure work. --Claude
summary: Four Mile Creek: live park page (closure only), April 2026 Wayback capture, reservation calendar (3 windows) + site photos + campground map, Esri/OSM, 3DEP read. Still closed for renovations, no reopening date, every campsite Unavailable through Oct 2027. 109 sites (81 RV, 20/30/50A + water, 40 sewer, 26-91 ft). Waterfront upgrade to creekside proposed (named creek-row sites). No rate (closed).

(all electric RV sites sold by the night when open; RV lengths 37-76 ft), the park's own map shows Four Mile Creek along the whole west row, and the site photos of 100 and 92 show the creek a few metres behind the pad over open leaf-litter ground with scattered trees (121 backs onto the bank). The creek is a small stream well under 30 m wide with an easy walk down. Canopy hides it on Esri imagery, so imagery can't veto or confirm.
